seo.title: Nadia Brooks | Chattanooga Real Estate Agent, Buying and Selling
seo.description: Chattanooga real estate agent for sellers and buyers in North Shore, St. Elmo, Highland Park, Red Bank and nearby. Home values answered within a day.

hero.headline: Chattanooga real estate, street by street.
hero.sub: I've sold houses here for eleven years, mostly in the neighborhoods on this map. Tap one and you get what I'd tell you on the drive over: the houses, the commute, and the one thing to check before you write an offer.

guide.title: The neighborhoods I know street by street
guide.hint: Tap a neighborhood for my notes. Drawn by hand, not to scale.
guide.fair: My notes cover houses, streets and drive times. For schools, I'll point you to Hamilton County Schools' own information so you can decide for yourself.

hoods.name: Signal Mountain
hoods.houses: Mid-century ranches and newer builds on big wooded lots
hoods.drive: 20 to 25 minutes, down the W Road
hoods.near: Trailheads, the overlooks, a small-town main street
hoods.note: Drive the W Road at 7:45 on a weekday before you make an offer.

hoods.name: Red Bank
hoods.houses: 1950s brick ranches with real yards, some flips
hoods.near: Dixie Highway shops, quick hop to the North Shore
hoods.note: The updated ones go fast. Get pre-approved before the first tour.

hoods.name: North Shore
hoods.drive: 5 minutes, or walk the Walnut Street Bridge
hoods.near: Coolidge Park, Frazier Avenue, the riverwalk
hoods.note: Parking is the question at every showing. Ask about it first.

hoods.name: Downtown & Southside
hoods.houses: Lofts, condos and new townhomes around Main Street
hoods.near: The Choo Choo, Main Street restaurants, the aquarium
hoods.note: With a condo, read the HOA's budget and reserves before you fall for the view.

hoods.name: Highland Park
hoods.houses: 1910s to 1940s bungalows on a street grid, renovated next to needs-work
hoods.note: Comps here go block by block. Two houses a street apart can price $80,000 apart.

hoods.name: St. Elmo
hoods.houses: 1890s to 1920s Victorians and bungalows at the foot of Lookout Mountain
hoods.near: The Incline Railway, the Guild Trail, St. Elmo Avenue's coffee and pizza
hoods.note: Old houses. Add a sewer scope to the inspection, every time.

hoods.name: East Brainerd
hoods.near: Hamilton Place shopping, the Enterprise South trails
hoods.note: Read the HOA rules on fences and sheds before closing, not after.

netsheet.title: Thinking of selling? A rough net sheet.
netsheet.sub: Slide in a price and your payoff to see roughly what you'd walk away with. When you're ready, I'll do a real one with title quotes and your exact payoff.
netsheet.note: Sample math, not an offer or a promise. Commission is whatever you agree to; it's negotiable. Taxes, HOA and repairs change the number.

I'm one agent, not a team, so the person you call is the person at the closing table. Most of my business is past clients and their friends. If one of them sent you, tell me who. I'll want to thank them.

booking.headline: Let's talk about your move.
booking.body: Three quick questions. I'll call or text you back within a day, and a home value request gets a price range from recent sales nearby.

faq.q: How do you figure out what my house is worth?
faq.a: From recent sales of similar houses nearby, adjusted for size, condition and the street. I send a written range, and after I walk the house I'll narrow it.

faq.q: What does it cost to sell?
faq.a: Commission is negotiable and we agree on it in writing before anything else. Then there's title, closing costs and prorations. The net sheet on this page gives you a rough idea.

faq.q: Do I need to be pre-approved before we tour?
faq.a: It helps, and in neighborhoods where the updated houses go fast it's almost required. I can introduce you to local lenders.

faq.q: Can you help if I'm moving from out of state?
faq.a: Yes. Video tours, a drive of the commute on your behalf, and a closing you can sign remotely if the title company allows it.

faq.q: Do you work with first-time buyers?
faq.a: A lot of them. I'll walk you through every step and every form, and there are no dumb questions.
